skills.name: design-system
skills.description: Create and maintain a consistent design system through component contracts, inventories, and verification, with separate workflows for evolving the system and building interfaces with it.

skills.name: good-readme
skills.description: Write or rewrite an open source README the way PostCSS, Nano ID, imgproxy, and AnyCable did it: lead with what the project does and how it differs, drop the badges, and never invent a benchmark the repo can't back up.

skills.name: inertia-go-forms
skills.omissions: Vue and Svelte examples are omitted because this template supports React; React workflows and Go replacements remain.

skills.name: inertia-go-pages
skills.omissions: Vue and Svelte examples are omitted because this template supports React; React workflows and Go replacements remain.

skills.name: intent-log
skills.description: Keep a shared record of what a person actually wanted, one short list per day tagged with the PRs it produced, so a teammate can catch up on a burst of agent-assisted work without reading every pull request. Written by the agent at the end of a session, not by hand.

skills.name: llms-visibility
skills.description: Make a site readable to ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and the coding agents that fetch URLs: Markdown routes, Accept content negotiation, llms.txt, and crawler signals in robots.txt. Pushes back on the AI-SEO advice we tested and found useless.

skills.name: sb-audit
skills.description: Periodic Storybook audit — naming-drift survey, archived/decision-board review, lifecycle tagging, usage refresh. Use for 'audit my Storybook', 'find drift', 'show pending decisions', or a periodic catalog health check.

skills.name: sb-explore
skills.description: Iterate on a new or redesigned component in a sandboxed Explore story outside src/components/ (+ Figma), checked against a graduation gate. Use for 'prototype this', 'try a v2', 'explore from Figma', or net-new UI not ready to ship.

skills.name: sb-figma
skills.description: The Figma↔Storybook bridge, both directions, via the native Figma MCP. design→code: map foundation tokens (color/spacing/type) from Figma variables with design↔code parity + drift, and deliver approved Figma components (extract → build → embed), authoring stories via sb-stories' rules. code→design: build Code Connect mappings from components + stories + token parity + usage so Figma Dev Mode shows the real code. Use for 'sync my Figma tokens', 'map Figma variables to my design system', 'deliver this approved Figma design', 'check design↔code token parity', 'connect my components to Figma / code connect'. NOT for prototyping/iterating an undecided design (that's sb-explore).

skills.name: sb-flows
skills.description: Map the whole app — routes, navigation edges, and persistent nav chrome, not just a screen list. Use for 'map the app', 'show the flow', 'app map', 'audit navigation', or 'how do screens connect'.

skills.name: sb-health
skills.description: Check design-system health for a React+Vite app — raw hex, undefined/unused tokens, scale gaps, DESIGN.md drift, and (opt-in) property→token-family misuse. Use for 'is my design system healthy', 'find raw colors', 'check tokens', or a mixed design system.

skills.name: sb-hub
skills.description: Hub for the Storybook CSF3 bundle — diagnose a repo, orchestrate the audit→stories pipeline, or name the next sb-* step. Use for 'set up Storybook', 'audit my app', 'where do I start', 'what's next'.

skills.name: sb-inventory
skills.description: Audit a React+Vite app for real-vs-slop components (by actual imports), the dominant design system, and real prop-value usage at call sites. Use for 'what components do I have', 'which are dead', 'audit this vibe-coded app'.

skills.name: sb-setup
skills.description: Set up Storybook on a React+Vite app that has none — defer to `npx storybook ai setup`, then align viteFinal/providers/MCP and ask where stories live. Use for 'set up Storybook', 'install Storybook', or NO_STORYBOOK.

skills.name: sb-ship
skills.description: Graduate ONE Explore experiment to a production component — preserve the experiment (cp, never git mv), pick new-vs-update, close the decision loop. Use for 'ship this', 'promote this experiment', 'graduate to production'.

skills.name: sb-stories
skills.description: Write a CSF3 story for ONE React component, covering only its materially-different states (no Cartesian), with a factory when 3+ stories share a shape. Use for 'write a story for X', 'document this component', 'add a Storybook story'.

skills.name: sb-wrappers
skills.description: Scaffold a Storybook-only wrapper — ABCanvas, StateGrid, AppFlowGraph, ProjectInventory, and more. Use for 'compare two designs', 'every state on one canvas', 'the full flow', 'track this decision', or 'scaffold wrappers'.

skills.name: secure-npm-package
skills.description: Release an npm package with no token left to steal: Trusted Publishing, provenance, and staged publishes from a single GitHub Actions workflow, plus click-by-click npmjs.com and GitHub settings with every URL resolved from your own package.json.

skills.name: skills-visibility
skills.description: Publish a catalog of agent skills and make it discoverable to AI coding agents: the .well-known/agent-skills/index.json index, integrity digests, single-file vs multi-file vs bundle packaging, and every install method. Pushes back on pointing the index at raw GitHub URLs instead of a domain you control.

skills.name: tailwind-best-practices
skills.description: Writes and audits Tailwind CSS with the five practices that keep a fast-to-write codebase maintainable: design tokens over magic values, short and consistently ordered class lists, semantically grouped tokens, and fixed variants for design-system components instead of arbitrary className props.
